name: sortable
title: Sortable
description: Reorder items by dragging them, within a list or between lists, with touch support.

classes.name: sortable-ghost
classes.description: Added by SortableJS to the placeholder while dragging; faded by sortable.css.

classes.name: sortable-handle
classes.description: A drag handle (cursor: grab). Use it with data-sortable-handle=".sortable-handle" and put the icon inside it, since icons ignore pointer events.

attributes.name: data-sortable-group
attributes.description: Lists with the same group name can exchange items.

attributes.name: data-sortable-handle
attributes.description: CSS selector of the drag handle inside each item. Without it the whole item drags.

attributes.name: data-sortable-parent-id
attributes.description: Sent as parent_id when saving, so the server knows which list an item landed in.

attributes.name: data-sortable-url
attributes.description: Optional. After a move, the item's new position (0-based) and parent_id are sent here as form data.

attributes.name: data-sortable-method
attributes.description: HTTP method used with data-sortable-url. Defaults to PATCH.

events.name: velle:sortable:move
events.description: Dispatched from the list an item landed in. event.detail has item, from, to, oldIndex and newIndex.

events.name: velle:sortable:success
events.description: The save request got a 2xx response. event.detail.response is the fetch Response.

events.name: velle:sortable:error
events.description: The save request failed. event.detail has response or error.

notes: Without data-sortable-url nothing is sent: listen for velle:sortable:move and save the order however you like.
Saving sends the X-CSRF-Token header when the page has <meta name="csrf-token">.
css-zero always sent a Rails-style PUT with query parameters; velle sends form data, only when data-sortable-url is set.
